entry_outcomes.name: ready
entry_outcomes.meaning: Required granted closure and capabilities fit the admitted selected profile.

entry_outcomes.name: adjusted
entry_outcomes.meaning: A visible lower visual/coverage profile fits; accepted facts/physics/authority do not change.

entry_outcomes.name: partial
entry_outcomes.meaning: Useful required closure is available; optional appearance/source/detail is missing, denied or capped.

entry_outcomes.name: refused
entry_outcomes.meaning: Required granted capability/support/data cannot fit or be provided; state the concrete reason.

entry_outcomes.name: materializing
entry_outcomes.meaning: Admitted required products are in progress with bounded queues and useful coarse coverage where valid.

entry_outcomes.name: offline-draft
entry_outcomes.meaning: Permitted cached viewing and local draft remain usable; no automatic mutation replay or new source/host requests.

entry_outcomes.name: reconcile
entry_outcomes.meaning: Same authority returns; resolve recorded request outcomes and current grants/base before explicit draft reconciliation.
